description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Soil Compaction for Centrifuge Model Construction is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ross Boulanger, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). The project is about soil compaction and how it contributes to engineering. The data provided helps to look at the differences in soil when using different types of compactors. This data will help give an understanding of what to expect when looking at different types of compacted soil. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gsa3-4j39. Keywords: University of California, Davis, Soil Compaction, Centrifuge, Soil Samples, 3D Modeling. Published 2022-09-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
